---
title: "Kdenlive"
---

Install Kdenlive for video editing and FFmpeg for media processing from the configured Fedora repositories.
The role uses Fedora's `ffmpeg-free` package; it does not add third-party repositories.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags video_editing
```

## Check

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
ffmpeg -version
kdenlive --version
```
:::

Fedora's `ffmpeg-free` build may not include every codec or encoder. If a workflow requires a codec unavailable in this build, consult the Fedora multimedia documentation before changing package sources.
